## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-*juǎn* prose commentary on the *[Shì Móhēyǎn lùn 釋摩訶衍論](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0084)* by the Táng or Five-Dynasties monk [法敏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%95%8F) (Fǎmǐn). The colophon "沙門法敏集" identifies the author as *shamen* and the verb 集 ("to assemble / collect"), suggesting partial compilation from earlier exegetical sources. The work is preserved only in the *Manji-zokuzōkyō* 卍續藏經 (X45). The text consists of "next-section-by-next-section" 次第屬當 commentary on the parent treatise, formatted with substantial extracts from the source text followed by Fǎmǐn's own analytical remarks.

**Abstract**

The text opens "次第屬當釋本論文刪補三卷別行 / 疏上 / 釋摩訶衍論十卷 / 龍樹菩薩造 / 沙門法敏集". The first verse organises the doctrinal material into "ten treatises" (十論), the last of which is the *Dà chéng qǐxìn lùn* itself — reflecting the *Shì Móhēyǎn lùn*'s self-presentation as the comprehensive Mahāyāna doctrinal scheme of which the *Awakening of Faith* is the doctrinal-foundational summary. The author Fǎmǐn is otherwise unattested in standard biographical sources; internal evidence places him loosely in the Tang or Five Dynasties period. The work survived only through Japanese manuscript transmission.
